# Native Desktop UI

## Start Here

[UI modules](../../../src/desktop/ui), [list keyboard helpers](../../../src/desktop/ui/lists.rs), [native tests](../../../src/desktop/ui/tests.rs), and [Windows smoke runner](../../../ci/desktop-smoke.ps1). Smoke helpers and feature flows live in [dot-sourced modules](../../../ci/desktop-smoke).

## Procedure and Invariants

Pinned Kit 0.8.0 retains the 0.7.3 workarounds described below; the [upgrade skill](../update-gpui/SKILL.md) owns version changes and API audits.

1. Follow pinned Kit patterns with stock typography/radii and normal Medium controls, including icon-only buttons. Palette adjustments are limited to the approved contrast-only correction in `design::apply_theme`, preserving the 4.5:1 checks. Keep blocking work off the UI thread and retain the 1000x640 client minimum with actual native layout evidence.
1. Use `gpui_kit::component::form::{Form, Field as FormField}` for repeated label/control layouts. Treat them as presentation only: keep application-owned input entities, stable control/accessibility IDs, validation and reset callbacks, and outer scroll IDs. Use normal unframed GroupBox for static sections; leave controlled collapsible state with its owner.
1. Fields use controlled Accordion by stable group ID; workspace/activity rich headers use Collapsible. Errors/search force groups open without overwriting collapse preference. Kit 0.7.3 Accordion is pointer-only: the approved public label-focus adapter handles unmodified Enter/Space and yields to inputs/popups. Ignore content-click callbacks that do not change openness, unmount closed inputs, and return focused corrected fields to the disclosure. Cover unsupported Choice feedback too with `controlled_group_` and native Schema flows. After remounting Fields, render the next layout frame before visibility assertions; MotionReveal initially measures the content while clipped.
1. GPUI Kit 0.7.3 windows use `gpui_kit::open_window` after `init`; return content, not another Root. Call it inside `cx.update` from async contexts. Base Root mounts component overlays once; do not manually render dialog/sheet/notification layers. Fixtures retain the returned content entity and checked Base-root handle. Keep application close guards and cover overlay focus/release with `root_overlay_` tests.
1. Kit Progress takes 0..100 percentages, not fractions; preserve calculation guards and give it an accessible name. Kit 0.7.3 `Progress` registers `.test_support()` directly, so `run-job-progress` and `update-download-progress` need no outer observation wrapper. The default Windows smoke verifies the actual progress role/range/zero-total value; headless debug accessibility is inactive by default. Styled Checkbox is binary; keep the centralized mixed-state adapter for aggregate selection.
1. For status/content reuse, preserve status child IDs/roles/names inside StatusBar; keep named polite wrappers around Marker when its public API cannot express the app's accessible name. Use Badge only with a nonzero host and existing status label. Kit 0.7.3 Alert lost the native accessible error name with a neutral wrapper; Results uses a presentational Marker inside the existing named Role::Alert wrapper instead. Keep exactly one assertive region, and ordinary progress/log-health messages non-assertive.
1. Lossless NumberInput fields explicitly select `MaskPattern::None` and call `InputState::set_step(None, window, cx)`; the 0.8.0 default is fixed step one. Keep min/max unset, route Step events through `adjust_field`, and retain Change handling. Use `.accessibility_label(field.label.clone())` on the spinner itself; a named Group is insufficient. Tests scope `increment`/`decrement` and `Role::SpinButton` by the field wrapper and observe the editable `("input", state.entity_id())` child after deferred events settle.
1. Source font size has a separate NumberInput preference adapter: unmasked integer entry in 10..24, valid changes through serialized preference saves, invalid text and steps never saved, last-valid restoration on Blur. Keep Reset and configuration drafts separate. `source_font_size_` inspects actual child values and saved bytes; activate fixture windows before testing Blur because inactive GPUI windows suppress focus events. Embedded step buttons fill the normal frame inside its border, not standalone-button heights. Name the spinner `Source font size` through `.accessibility_label(...)`; Windows reports focus on that Spinner owning the sole Edit child. Verify the name/ownership and read the Edit's ValuePattern.
1. Preserve unsaved-draft guards, tab identity, focus, keyboard selection, and disabled/confirmation states. Source feedback is debounced/single-flight; `source-validation-pending` replaces the green check while inspecting. Wait for current feedback before asserting reconciled selection, but keep native text/history and Save guards immediate. Stable test IDs may need an outer wrapper when scrollbar helpers replace an element ID.
1. External VS Code actions use the [shared launcher](../../../src/desktop/vscode.rs), off the UI thread, with `--new-window` and an explicit absolute workspace folder. VS Code reuses a matching folder window before creating another; include the repository root when also opening a Git file. Preserve Windows verbatim/UNC path identity and literal process arguments. Discover the installed executable, not a shell command or `vscode://` fallback. Do not use `--reuse-window`, which can replace an unrelated workspace. Ordinary tests must not open real editor windows.
1. Workspace text files use Source only, including breadcrumb navigation and Save As. Clear schema providers and switch to the toolkit's `text` highlighter when leaving YAML/JSON; keep binary rows disabled for pointer and keyboard activation. Cover this with the `workspace_files_` native tests.
1. Keep [Source line commands](../../../src/desktop/ui/source.rs) scoped to `RegressifySource > Input` and the actual source focus handle. Menus restore that handle through `action_context`. Preserve Tab completion, dismiss-only Shift+Tab while suggestions are open, shared document undo/redo, exclusive end-line bounds, reversed selections, and JSON's no-comments rule. Source captures native history actions; ordinary Fields inputs retain local undo for invalid drafts. Keep Find/Replace busy/open guards and provider-gated Suggest consistent. Test disabled menu items by pointer behavior; their wrapper may not expose a disabled-state value.
1. Scope list shortcuts to a retained list focus handle, excluding search and editor inputs. Reuse the owning selection methods; suite/scenario keyboard ranges and Ctrl+A use visible rows, while scenario selection preserves other suites. Keep single-selection lists single-select and operation locks intact.
1. Workspace files, captures and action sequences use Kit List/ListItem virtualization. Keep short-list fit and exact post-scroll/drag/Home/End assertions, but do not require offscreen rows to remain mounted. Workspace paths and capture keys drive refresh identity; sequence IDs are UI-only, explicitly permuted on known edits and invalidated for ambiguous external duplicates. Defer leased delegate callbacks, reject stale scopes/snapshots and keep suite/scenario checked/open/focused policy in their existing controller.
1. Overview uses retained TableState/DataTable with uniform 64px rows, `header_row_height(Size::Medium.table_row_height())` (32px), and suite-path refresh identity. Keep row cursor separate from checked suites and guarded Edit/Open Report. Details opens only through its control or Enter on the actual table focus, with complete read-only selectable text and CopyText. Preserve focus return and weak ownership. Unsortable header content uses declared column width to avoid Kit's reserved sort-icon inset; verify exact header/body bounds. Source diagnostics remain variable-height and unchanged.
1. Command search uses actionless Kit CommandItem with stock case-insensitive substring matching on title/category. Keep the existing catalog and guards. The one-shot confirmation callback closes the dialog, restores workbench focus, then dispatches exactly once; never attach an item Action as well. Kit owns two-step Escape (clear query, then propagate dismissal). Preserve disabled/empty results and native accessible row names. After testing a disabled row click, refocus the captured query handle before typing another query.
1. For keyboard-scrolled rows, share `track_scroll` with an explicit scrollbar on a stationary, relative parent; Kit 0.7.3 `.scrollbar()`/`.vertical_scrollbar()` append an overlay that moves and clips if attached to the scrolling element itself. Keep rows as the tracked container's direct children for `scroll_to_item`; the convenience overflow wrapper owns a separate handle. Cover wheel-to-bottom then thumb-drag-to-top with `navigator_scrollbar_` and landing tests. Virtualized lists use their uniform-list handle and filtered positions.
1. Use real pointer/keyboard tests for menus/dialogs; model tests alone cannot establish interaction behavior. Settle dialog animations with existing helpers. Wait for actionable dialog controls: a painted Windows dialog title may not expose a standalone UIA name.
1. Use Kit's `click_with_modifiers`, scoped role queries, and `TestEventExt` pointer steps instead of local gesture dispatchers. Clicks restore prior modifiers; pointer/scroll helpers retain them. Explicit Ctrl-wheel tests must release through `change_modifiers` before plain scrolling. `TestInput` composition ranges are UTF-16, unlike Source's scalar LSP positions; it is not a native OS IME test.
1. Use DialogFooter for existing action-row layout, retaining explicit busy/disabled buttons, wrapping and application callbacks. About's public DialogClose uses `.trigger` and an observed `about-close` wrapper because the inner button ID is `close`; its native group is `About actions`. Scope native Close clicks to that group, not the titlebar X. Keep filename confirm-focus routing and multi-action save/confirmation policies intact.
1. Normal toolbar controls use Toolbar/ToolbarGroup with `Size::Medium` and auto height for wrapping. Non-Sizable dropdown wrappers use `content` after preparing/sizing the button trigger. The approved `design::ToolbarFocus` adapter handles 0.7.3 backward-wrap failure using bounded forward tab order; keep individual disabled guards, child input keys and modified arrows intact. Yield while `GlobalState::is_in_deferred_context` is true so raw key handling cannot steal menu arrows. `toolbar_` tests and native Add-to-More/log-caret checks verify this.
1. New/Rename suite dialogs focus and select the filename stem after opening. Route Enter from inputs or the primary action to the guarded asynchronous commit; Cancel/X keyboard activation must remain cancellation. gpui-kit styled buttons own internal focus handles, so use a parent focus region for default-action routing. Keep X/Cancel/Escape/backdrop dismissal blocked while busy, and retain invalid input after failed writes. Test disabled controls through their effects when wrapper metadata omits the disabled flag.
1. Suite context actions and F2/Delete target the focused row, not the open editor or all checked rows. Keep `RegressifySuiteList` separate from inputs; no global F2 binding. Test Results targeting, dirty cancellation, independent filename/display-name edits, and confirmed artifact deletion with `desktop::ui::tests::suite_panel_`.
1. Managed suite/image context menus use explicit generation-scoped trigger IDs and ContextMenuExt. Capture-phase suite focus must not block toolkit bubbling; reject stale suite builders/actions. The approved `design::restore_managed_menu_focus` helper weakly defers focus repair only while the dismissed popup still owns focus, preserving a newer menu/dialog. Keep refresh/mode/visibility invalidation and window-release tests; do not retain manual popup mounts.
1. Value selectors retain state by binding/panel identity and use `SearchableVec`, not plain Vec, for real filtering. Setters emit no user Confirm but `set_selected_value` clears search; skip unchanged synchronization. Preserve unknown values with feedback, route Confirm through existing guards, and synchronize Reset and rejected choices without writing displayed defaults.
1. Select/Combobox option text uses the shared `ValueChoice` renderer with `Role::Label` and `aria_value(title)`: the Windows adapter takes a Label's native name from its value, not `aria_label`. Plain strings and label-only wrappers produced unnamed native rows. Keep the stable observed value ID; native default/Git/Publishing/Deployment verify actual names and pointer choices without toolkit edits.
1. Always-available copies use `design::CopyText` around Clipboard. Key feedback by exact-value generation so changed or revisited text copies immediately; keep unchanged text's two-second suppression. Preserve stable wrapper IDs/names, exact source and weak status callbacks. Clipboard has no disabled API: gated empty/incomplete logs, exports and unavailable Results URL/menu copies keep their existing Buttons. `clipboard_copy_` covers keyboard, exact encoded text, repeat/change identity and disappearance.
1. Capture Log source tabs use segmented TabBar with an approved two-handle keyboard adapter: Kit 0.7.3 Tab is pointer-only. Explicit tab stops and Enter/Space hooks preserve activation; the owning toolbar handles arrows. Assert actual FocusHandles because Tab observation omits focus metadata. Native default checks Right/Enter and Left/Space. Non-tail archives use compact Pagination and explicit page status; rolling Follow stays separate.
1. Windows/Linux AppMenuBar retains owned menu snapshots and reloads only changed flags. File uses AppFileCommand to avoid the focused suite-row FileCommand route. Before reload, synchronously dispatch public base Cancel only when the menu scope owns focus. Kit 0.7.3 menus strongly own their bar: release through the public empty-reload helper, restoring the shared registry afterward. Keep `app_menu_` exact-target, focus, release and two-window tests; macOS retains its prior in-window menus.
1. Bound the titlebar content by the viewport and supported native caption slots; long workspace names must not set its intrinsic width. Keep matching text size/alignment, 16px group gaps, and normal workspace foreground. The version hides below 1080px and the workspace name hides below 1400px, including live resize. Titlebar tabs alone use Small sizing to bring their underline closer without reducing text size; retain the tested margin compensation. Native Appearance/Add dropdown triggers do not reliably accept UIA SetFocus, and Appearance lacks InvokePattern: use bounded real Tab navigation with exact focus and Enter/Escape checks. Ordinary commands retain native Invoke checks. The menu catalog is File/Publish/Help, not Edit.
1. Guided list fields use multiple Combobox beside the raw textarea. Change applies one guarded toggle; Confirm/Escape never writes or rolls back. Resolve controlled selection against the full list before restoring search, retain unavailable entries, and wait for viewport discovery before classifying them. Pointer tests use stable `choice-option-<value>` row content; refocus the open search before typing after a row click. Default smoke toggles twice in one open popup, then Escape closes it.
1. Exercise compact/large windows, long labels, light/dark/system themes, scroll, clipboard selection, and accessibility names. Inspect actual rendered screenshots.
1. Normal-sized scrollable fixtures must bring their actual target into view before clicking, retaining every behavioral assertion. Cover large-to-minimum resize: the collapsed-workspace-files sidebar reserves a 256px suite minimum, while expanded files retain their existing height budget. `navigator_suite_rows_remain_clickable_after_minimum_resize` and `workspace_files_scroll_within_sidebar_at_both_window_sizes` cover both cases.
1. A checked sidebar scenario is not necessarily the editor selection after Source reconciliation. Native default smoke explicitly opens Checkout before its compact Fields/Actions checks; settings search alone cannot reveal scenario actions at suite scope.
1. Windows smoke requires an unlocked interactive desktop and no other app instances because it temporarily changes shared preferences. Ask the user to leave input untouched. Activate the exact fixture HWND before process fallback; do not reactivate an already-focused source editor. Verify foreground ownership before input. Never bypass guards or close the user's windows.
1. Smoke shortcuts use `Send-FixtureKeys <ConsoleKey> -Control -Shift -Alt` as needed; literal text uses `Send-FixtureText`. Keep modifier pairs and extended navigation flags in the shared native helper, and retain caret/control outcome checks. Start a fresh PowerShell session after changing inline `Add-Type` definitions.
1. Source focus checks must compare the actual focused accessibility element, not the editor wrapper's `HasKeyboardFocus`. `-SchemaFlows`/`-SourceFlows` use Alt+Tab to an owned temporary window, native return activation, and Enter/Tab/Escape without clicking the editor. The temporary window owns an STA `Application.Run` loop, waits for Alt release on that thread, and closes/joins in `finally`; polling `DoEvents` on the driver left Alt latched and produced false key failures. Keep exact source/menu assertions and never reset OS modifiers to conceal failure.
1. For smoke selections requiring an exclusive column-zero endpoint, finish with `Shift+Home` and assert the caret and exact edited text. Vertical key movement can land a character past the boundary; GUI regressions must exercise keys, not only `set_selected_range`.
1. Native pointer clicks and diagnostic text drags synchronize compositor frames after movement and press; always release in `finally` and settle the release. Back-to-back native mouse events can miss the target even when frame-stepped GPUI tests pass. Keep pointer/drag sequencing and failure cleanup covered by the headless harness, and wait for a changed clipboard sequence before checking selected diagnostic text.
1. Native copy checks, including Overview Details, set a synthetic sentinel, record `GetClipboardSequenceNumber`, trigger the copy, then use `Wait-FixtureClipboardText` to await both a changed sequence and exact text. Emptying the clipboard can advance its sequence before text is available; keep both conditions inside the bounded, frame-paced wait, without reading while the sequence is unchanged. Retry only `CLIPBRD_E_CANT_OPEN` within the bounded clipboard helper, preserve backup/restore in `finally`, and never log clipboard contents. Unrecovered failures may report elapsed time, exception type and HRESULT only; always rethrow the original error.
1. The native runner owns an independent user clipboard snapshot across the entire flow and restores it in outer `finally`, including partial initialization failure. Clone mutable data and copy complete streams while preserving their positions. Reject unsupported/unreadable user formats before mutation; only an explicitly fixture-owned scope may drop unavailable private formats. Cover disconnected providers, empty streams, binary types, and failure cleanup in the headless harness.
1. Remote management has a distinct accessible `Save remote` command so the form's submit action cannot be confused with the disabled Add/Rename toolbar controls. Test dropdowns through their popup items after they render. Keep activity below the diff pane so expanded logs cannot collapse file trees; compact tests must include expanded comparison rows, not only visible commit controls.
1. Publishing controls live in the global Publish menu. Bound long token-selector labels so Add/Edit/Remove remain inside the dialog. Landing forms retain an explicit scroll handle; offscreen inputs may not have accessibility nodes until scrolled into view. Use distinct landing deployment labels, settle password focus after native clicks, and wait for menu-driven form changes before asserting them.
1. Report and landing deployment dialogs expose the selected target's saved URL through `deploy-open-published` and `deploy-copy-published`. Use the native link style without an external icon, content-sized and left-aligned, with Copy beside it and visible for long URLs. Omit report suite listings but retain subset confirmation. Test disk reload, provider switching, pointer copy, and compact light/dark layouts.
1. Cloudflare target routing defaults to Public (production). Preserve advanced HTML/date/exclusion settings and masked credentials across edits. Keep expanded asset settings scrollable without losing the outer dialog accessibility ID; GPUI's scrollbar wrapper changes element type. `label()` in native tests reads the accessibility name when one overrides visible text. Hide public-link controls for successful private deployments.
1. Deployment activity uses the shared read-only log editor at full remaining height, not static tail lines. Keep the suite summary ellipsized and hide its capture-statistics row. Test native selection/copy with a clipboard sentinel, long lines, compact/large windows, and a distinct editor accessibility name. Runs Open Site belongs beside Open Report and resolves saved publication membership by output ID, not display name.
1. Background Git activity refresh must position the log with a non-focusing range update; `set_cursor_position` focuses the editor and can steal remote/commit input. In smoke, synchronize asynchronous copy through bounded exact-content checks; inspect the current split diff, not the obsolete raw-editor control. Deployment failure details belong to its error banner; archived logs carry structured outcomes.

## Checks

For smoke harness edits, run `./ci/test-desktop-smoke.ps1` in PowerShell 7 first. These [headless checks](../../../ci/test-desktop-smoke.ps1) cover module loading, switch dispatch, failure cleanup, native key-event sequences, and draft state without Windows UI or settings changes. Keep shared process and cleanup variables in the runner's script scope; do not replace dot-sourcing with child-scope script invocation or module imports.

```sh
cargo test --features desktop --lib desktop::vscode::tests
cargo test --features gui-tests --lib workspace_external_menus_
cargo test --features gui-tests --lib suite_name_dialog_
cargo test --features gui-tests --lib root_overlay_
cargo test --features gui-tests --lib value_selector_
cargo test --features gui-tests --lib choice_combobox_
cargo test --features gui-tests --lib source_line_commands
cargo test --features gui-tests --lib external_reload
cargo test --features gui-tests --lib deployment_activity_
cargo test --features gui-tests --lib runs_open_site_
cargo test --features gui-tests --lib desktop::ui
```

Run the relevant `./ci/desktop-smoke.ps1` switch, such as `-SchemaFlows`, `-ComparisonFlows`, or `-GitFlows`; the default flow includes pointer-focused suite/scenario/checklist shortcuts. `-SchemaFlows` also covers source line commands, the Edit menu, automatic external reload after Source saves, and conflict cancellation/confirmation with compact/large light/dark screenshots. Use `-SkipBuild` only with a current binary. Capture flows may require managed Chromium. Do not use browser automation as a substitute for this native UI's tests.

`-SourceFlows` reuses the Source typing/completion/line-command/save/reload/conflict assertions without the Fields/diagnostic-panel checks; it is not a substitute for full `-SchemaFlows` when those surfaces change. Both initialize the schema suite fixture, and full Schema wins when both switches are set. Headless checks cover fixture bytes, dispatch/cleanup, and native focus-host compilation without opening windows.

`-ArtifactFlows` also exercises New/Rename filename focus and stem selection, Enter from inputs/focused Create, X cancellation, F2 rename, independent display-name editing in Rename and Fields, byte-preserving reference/history migration, and Delete cancellation/confirmation. Inputs and the deletion prompt need accessible names, not only visible text or test IDs.

`-CleanupFlows` covers cleanup previews/cancellation in both themes and sizes, then selective deletion with protected full-suite results, baselines, and unselected suites. Run `cleanup_dialog_` GUI tests first; see [run retention](../run-retention/SKILL.md).

`-PublishingFlows` covers automatic landing storage, Markdown/remote URLs, draft guards, local removal, named tokens, Cloudflare account inheritance, and both themes/window sizes. It backs up/restores global catalogs and cannot use KeepOpen.

`-DeploymentFlows` covers synthetic target URL reload, native link/adjacent Copy, Runs Open Site placement, exact deployment-log copying, and missing-token outcomes without remote publication. It preserves clipboard data around copy checks.

## Maintain

Update [desktop docs](../../../docs/desktop.md), matching smoke scenarios, [update-gpui](../update-gpui/SKILL.md), and this skill. Comment toolkit workarounds and ownership rules only where non-obvious.
